mapfrontiers.accept_frontier_desc:
Accepting will give you a copy of the sent frontier.
You will own the frontier and be able to edit it.
Changes made by both players won't be visible to the other.
mapfrontiers.accept_frontier_desc_replac:
You already have this frontier.
You can choose whether to replace the current one or create a new one to keep both.
mapfrontiers.change_to_global_frontier_d: Are you sure you want to change the frontier to global?

This frontier will be visible to all players.
Any player with sufficient permissions will be able to edit or delete it.
mapfrontiers.change_to_personal_frontier: Are you sure you want to change the frontier to personal?
No player will be able to see the frontier except you.
mapfrontiers.create_temporary_collection:
Temporary collections only exist in this session.
They are not saved, not synchronized, and will disappear when you leave the world.
mapfrontiers.create_temporary_frontier_d:
Temporary frontiers only exist in this session.
They are not saved, not synchronized, and will disappear when you leave the world.
mapfrontiers.delete_collection_dialog: Are you sure you want to delete the collection?
mapfrontiers.delete_collection_dialog_de:
The frontiers in this collection won't be deleted.
They will remain without collection.
mapfrontiers.delete_frontier_dialog: Are you sure you want to delete the frontier?
mapfrontiers.delete_frontier_dialog_desc:
This won't delete the frontier for everyone.
You will only lose access to it.
mapfrontiers.delete_group_dialog: Are you sure you want to delete the group?
mapfrontiers.delete_user_dialog: Are you sure you want to delete the user?
mapfrontiers.frontier_changed_dialog_des:
Another player changed this frontier while the dialog was open.
Do you want to apply your changes anyway?
mapfrontiers.send_description:
The mod wasn't detected on the server, so you can't share the frontier.
You can send a copy to other players via chat, and if they have the mod, they'll be able to accept it.
They won't see any changes you make afterward,
and you'll have to send them the frontier again if you want them to see the changes.

mapfrontiers.group_everyone_desc: This group represents all players without exception.
mapfrontiers.group_ops_desc:
In multiplayer this group represents players with OP permissions.
In singleplayer it represents the main player of the game.
mapfrontiers.group_owners_desc:
This group represents the owners of the frontiers.
The only actions that can be configured are Delete and Update frontiers.
